name: robinbohmgmbh-website
description: Website der Robin Böhm GmbH – React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, vorgerendert für GitHub Pages.

scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.build:staging: tsc -b && vite build --mode staging && vite build --mode staging --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs
